title: Config
description: The keys of podrunner.toml (docs/configuration.md). `podrunner check --config FILE` is the last word: the floors, the pin list and the modes of the files are not in this schema.

cache.description: The cache of `serve` (T-480); none: no job gets a cache.

dns.description: The resolver of the egress and of a remote mint (T-076).

driver_dir.description:
The directory of the driver executables (the podvm binary, the
sidecars): each one must be in it (GitHub #36).

guest_kinds.description:
The unit kinds whose claim of `guest` slots may accept, after the
guest self-test (GitHub #36).

host.description: The name of the host in the full report.

max_units.description:
The most units of the host across its kinds (T-505); none: the
`slots` of each kind only.

payload_from_offer.description: Take the payload of an offer when it is on the pin list.

repository.description:
The one repository (`owner/repo`) that the host serves; an offer of
another repository is `repo-scope-refused`. `trusted` at
`redirect` needs it (DR-4).

same_principal_ok.description: More than one unit at a time on a shared principal.

terminal_suppress_s.description: A terminal refusal suppresses its job id for this time.

upstream_names_only.description:
The upstream proxy takes names only: the broker sends it the checked
name, and checks at the start that it refuses a non-public one.

upstream_proxy.description:
The CONNECT proxy of the way out of the egress module (`http://host:port`);
absent: direct.

warm_reserve.description: The memory that warm units leave free (T-487): a size, default `1G`.

Boundary.description:
The boundary between a job and the host, weakest first. `redirect`
rewrites file paths and is no isolation against hostile code.

dir.description: The directory of the caches: an absolute path; default `STATE/cache`.

env.description:
A variable of the runner and a relative path under the cache, for
example `npm_config_cache = "npm"`. Only a `rw` job gets them. Only
a known cache variable is taken (`npm_config_cache`,
`PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`, `RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE` and more).

key.description: The key of a job whose offer gives none. Default `default`.

max_age_s.description: A cache with no use in this time goes. Default 7 days.

max_bytes.description:
The most bytes of one cache; above it, the cache is emptied after
its next `rw` job. Default 10 GiB.

total_bytes.description:
The most bytes of the directory; above it, the caches with the
oldest use go. Default 50 GiB.

write_refs.description:
The refs whose jobs write the cache (the default branch of each
repository). Default `["refs/heads/main"]`: a branch named `main`,
also where the default branch is another one.

Deadlines.description: The time limit of each state, in seconds.

DnsConfig.description:
`[dns]`: the resolver of podrunner (`pod-dns`): the system, the cache of
addresses that carried a session, DNS over HTTPS to resolvers by their
address. A host whose own resolver fails keeps its egress and its mint.

doh.description: Ask DNS over HTTPS when the system and the cache give no address.

pins.description: `HOST=IP` pins: a pinned name is not asked of the system.

EgressConfig.description:
`[egress]` (T-111): an unknown key is refused, so a misspelled
`default_policy` does not leave the operator with no ceiling.

default_policy.description:
The `broker-policy.v1` of the operator: the policy of a job with no
policy of its own, and the ceiling of the policy of an offer (T-024,
T-107).

secrets.description:
The secrets of the host that a credential of a policy names, by
name (T-563).

Event.description:
The event that started the workflow. Each value that the tier rule does
not name is `other`; a value that the source cannot read is `unknown`.

ForgeTrust.description: The lists of one forge of a source.

Organization.description:
A configured organization. With an `id`, an offer that carries
`owner_id` must match it too.

Payload.description: A pinned payload of one architecture.

assignment_hook.description: The runner hook requests an assignment verdict before any job step.

built_at_s.description: The time of the build, in seconds of the Unix epoch.

container_engine.description: The payload carries the Docker engine binaries for a guest.

init.description:
The PID 1 that the payload needs: `image` for an image that boots
its own init (systemd). Placement sends it only to a kind with the
same `init` (T-549).

labels.description:
The `runs-on` labels that this payload serves (no case). An offer
with one of them takes a payload that names it, not one with no
labels; empty: each offer (T-549).

max_age_s.description:
The age limit of this pin; the smaller of it and `max_age_s` of
`[pin]` holds.

runner_version.description: The version of the official runner in the image (`2.338.2`).

sandbox.description:
The image of a sandbox (T-506): only an offer with `sandbox` of
this digest takes it, and a runner job never does.

unpacked_bytes.description:
The bytes of the image unpacked (its tree, `du -sxb /` in a unit).
`check` refuses a pin above the root disk of a kind that runs it
(T-551) or above `(mem - 512 MiB) × 4 / 13` of a microvm guest
(T-573), and placement refuses an offer whose `disk` limit is below it
on a kind with `root_quota` (T-571). Absent: not checked.

max_age_s.description: An image older than this is `image-stale`.

signer.description:
The Ed25519 key (64 hex digits) that signs the pin list, and its
signature (128 hex digits): `podrunner pin-sign` (DR-4).

PublicRepo.description: A public repository that the operator trusts (`owner/repo`).

file.description:
The file of the value (mode 0600 or 0400). One end of line at the
end is not part of the value. slots reads it at the start of each
unit, so a new value needs no restart.

hosts.description:
The hosts that may get the value (as the `host` of a rule): each
host of a credential that names the secret is one of them, or under
a `*.NAME` of them.

places.description:
The places of a request where the broker may put the value (`in` of
a credential: `header`, `basic`, `query`, `body`). Default: `header`
and `basic`. A credential with a wider `in` is refused: a value in a
body or a query can reach a host that keeps it and shows it again.

sources.description:
The sources whose offers may name the secret. A credential of
`default_policy` that names it holds for a job of these sources
only; a job of another source is refused.

SourceConfig.description: One source instance: one set of one tier, one architecture, one host.

allow_personal_account.description:
`github-scaleset`: serve a repository of a personal account
(`config_url` names the repository; T-504, the owner's Q13). Off by
default: the sidecar refuses a personal account (`repo-scope-refused`,
call C3). The App needs "Administration: write" on the repository.

mint.description:
`remote`: the address of the mint (`host:port`), the pin of its key
(`sha256/BASE64`), and the certificate of this host (its key is
`key_file`, a P-256 key at mode 0600).

operator_controlled.description:
True when the operator controls the source: it gets the full run
report.

program.description:
`program`: the program, in `driver_dir`, and its argv. Its credential
file is `key_file` (optional, mode 0400 or 0600): the program gets
its path in `PODRUNNER_SOURCE_KEY_FILE`, never its content.

sidecar.description:
`github-scaleset`: the sidecar, the organization URL, the REST API,
the installation and the App, the scale set, and the file of the
private key of the App (mode 0400 or 0600).

slots.description: The most units of this source at one time (no limit when absent).

token_file.description:
`github-scaleset`: a fine-grained token of the organization (mode
0400 or 0600) in place of the App (T-174).

trust.description: The trust lists of this source, in place of `[trust]` (T-494).

oneOf.description:
A remote mint over mutual TLS (GitHub #31): the source and its
credentials live on another machine.
A program that speaks the source wire on its stdio (T-101, G-01).

SourceTrust.description: The trust lists of one source.

anyOf.description: One table for each offer of the source.

Tier.description:
The trust tier of a job. It comes from the trust inputs of an offer,
never from a label; `local` comes only from the configuration.

oneOf.description: A pull request from a fork.
A member job of a configured organization.

TierConfig.description: The configuration that the rule reads.

extra_events.description:
More events that a trusted job may come from: only those of
[`EXTRA_EVENTS`] (the owner, Q5 and Q12).

users.description:
Personal accounts whose repositories the operator trusts (T-191): a
forge with repositories of a person (a `program` source). The
GitHub scale set refuses a personal account at its start (call C3)
unless its source sets `allow_personal_account` (T-504).

UnitConfig.description: The slots of one unit kind.

binary.description: The tool of the kind (`podvm`: the path of the podvm binary).

claim.description:
`fake`, with `allow_fake`: the boundary that the fake kind claims and
an enforced hold, for a test of a forge source (T-511). A test only.

command.description: The top process of a unit: the runner in the payload.

confine.description:
`podvm`: run each unit and container under the confine layer of
podvm (`--podvm-confine`, T-079). The kind says `confined` only
after its self-test on this host.

disk_max_bytes.description:
The bytes that a unit may write under its root, measured every
30 s (T-074); a `disk` limit of the offer comes first. Absent: no
measure.

engine.description:
`microvm`: the directory of the static Docker binaries; each guest
runs an engine of its own (T-103).

images.description: The store of the pinned images (`podvm`: a podvm store).

init.description:
`incus`, `microvm`: the PID 1 of each unit. `image`: the init of the
image (systemd of the hosted snapshot) with its own services and
engine: `--podvm-init=image --podvm-engine` on the incus tier
(T-543), `--podvm-init=image` on the machine tier (T-549). Absent:
podvm's own. The other kinds refuse it (T-549).

mem.description:
`microvm`: the most memory of each guest (`--podvm-mem`, default
`8G`) and its vCPUs (default 2). The image is an uncompressed
initramfs: podvm needs 13/4 times the image plus 512 MiB, and `check`
refuses a pin whose `unpacked_bytes` is over `(mem - 512 MiB) × 4 /
13` (T-573). An offer lowers the memory, not below the boot floor and
the image: the `memory` of the offer is beyond the image (T-655).
`podvm`: the memory of each unit (`RLIMIT_AS`);
`incus`: the memory and the CPUs of each instance (T-162).

pids.description:
`podvm`, `incus`: the most processes of each unit (T-162). `mem`
and, on `incus`, `cpus` are limits there too.

podnet.description:
`podvm`: the `podnet` binary that holds the egress of each unit
(`podnet pod`, T-065); absent: no hold (`egress_hold: unknown`).

registries.description:
The registry hosts of the container images of a job (`ghcr.io`),
for `container: hooks`. None: each container is refused.

root_quota.description:
`incus`: the pool holds a size of a root disk (not `dir`): each root
is the lesser of the `disk` of the offer and `disk_max_bytes` (T-482).

runner_dir.description:
The runner directory in a unit, as the runner names it; absent: the
path that the driver observes (the fake unit).

warm.description:
The warm units of the kind (T-487): a count for an offer with no
label of a payload, or a table of `runs-on` label to count (`*`: no
such label). Each holds a slot of the kind and a unit of
`max_units`.

warm_max_age_s.description: A warm unit older than this ends and is made again (default 3600).

work_folder.description:
`podvm`, `incus`, `microvm`: the work folder of the runner in each
unit, an absolute path (T-541, T-590). podrunner writes it into
`.runner` of the credential, so `GITHUB_WORKSPACE` is
`FOLDER/REPO/REPO`. Absent: the hosted path `/home/runner/work`
(`podvm`: `work` in its `runner_dir`). A podvm folder is in its
`runner_dir`: the container hooks mount only there.

UnitInit.description:
The PID 1 of a unit: `[unit.KIND] init` of a kind (what it boots) and
`[[pin.payload]] init` of a payload (what it needs). Absent: podvm's
own init. Placement sends a payload only to a kind with the same value
(T-549).

oneOf.description:
The init of the image (`--podvm-init=image`): systemd boots the
services of the image.

WarmCount.description: `[unit.KIND] warm`: one count, or a count for each label.
